export const recordTourEventAction = async (...args) => {
	(window.__serverCalls ||= []).push({
		fn: "recordTourEventAction",
		file: "app/actions/tour-preferences.ts"
	});
	console.warn("[harness] server action called", "recordTourEventAction");
	return {
		success: false,
		error: "harness",
		data: null
	};
};
export default {};
